description:
Mikhail, the strongest man in another world, turns into a golden retriever whenever he's around Sena? One day, a door to a dungeon suddenly opens in the basement, and a mysterious man appears. 

*“Here, we eat chicken whenever something happy or sad happens.”*
*“Miss… please, take me in as your servant.”*

A man who wants to become your servant just because you fed him chicken — can you handle that? As if that wasn’t enough, turns out I’m a descendant of a legendary archmage? Sena’s already confused, but now her sweet little brother joins in with a barrage of unexpected confessions? 

And yet… the mukbang must go on. A bond born from chicken — can it transcend the boundaries between fantasy and reality? For those worn out by the spicy chaos of everyday life, get ready for a sweet and savory dungeon romance.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
